display_long_description:
# Step inside real science.

10k Science turns real scientific research data into immersive VR worlds you can explore on Meta Quest.

Zoom from everyday life into cells, molecules, ecosystems, and hidden microscopic worlds. See how CRISPR can treat sickle cell disease. Investigate why vineyard plants are dying. Follow wildfire smoke into the lungs. Discover how tarantula venom could inspire new pain medicine. Explore how dolphins use sound to sense the world.

This is not a video or a textbook. It is an interactive science documentary you can step inside.

Your AI science guide talks you through each experience, asks questions, and responds to your spoken answers as you explore.

## Free download includes

- **CRISPR & Sickle Cell**: Explore gene editing inside the human body.
- **Trouble in Sunshine Creek**: Investigate a vineyard mystery involving invasive insects, plant disease, and microscopic biology.

## Subscribe to unlock more

- **Pain & Painkillers**: See how tarantula venom could inspire new ways to treat pain.
- **Wildfire, Air Quality & Respiration**: Follow smoke from the air into the lungs.
- **Seeing with Sound**: COMING SOON! Discover how porpoises and whales use sound to understand their surroundings.

Built for curious minds who love science shows, museum exhibits, nature documentaries, biology, medicine, technology, and asking, "wait, how does that actually work?"

Schools and organizations: contact us for classroom licensing.
